title: Independent systems of orientation columns in upper and lower layers of monkey visual cortex.
abstract: Using a multi-microelectrode, in 5 animals, orientation tuning was measured simultaneously in 30 closely spaced parallel penetrations perpendicular to the surface of the striate cortex. Actual penetration angles were determined by three-dimensional track reconstruction. Above and below layer IVc, two columnar systems were found whose orientation angles were independent.
